title: Continuous Improvement Engineer
description:
Syensqo is all about chemistry. We’re not just referring to chemical reactions here, but also to the magic that occurs when the brightest minds get to work together. This is where our true strength lies. In you. In your future colleagues and in all your differences. And of course, in your ideas to improve lives while preserving our planet’s beauty for the generations to come.
  
**We are looking for:**

* A skilled Continual Improvement Engineer to drive process optimization and operational excellence across the organization and utilize methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, and other quality management tools to identify opportunities, implement improvements, and sustain best practices, supporting Syensqo mission of scientific exploration and breakthrough advancement.

**We count on you for:**

* Process Analysis & Optimization: Analyze current processes, identify inefficiencies, and recommend improvements to enhance productivity, quality, and safety.
* Project Management: Lead and support improvement projects from conception through implementation, ensuring timely delivery and measurable results.
* Data Collection & Analysis:Gather and analyze data to identify trends, root causes, and areas for improvement using statistical tools.
* Training & Coaching: Train and mentor employees on continuous improvement methodologies and best practices.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with production, quality, engineering, and other teams to ensure alignment and successful implementation of improvement initiatives.
* Performance Monitoring: Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of improvement activities.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate records of process changes, project progress, and outcomes.

**You can count on us for:**

* The chance to build a strong network across functions and manufacturing locations.
* Significant investment in your professional development to prepare you for future roles within the organization.
* An inclusive workplace culture that values and respects individual differences and backgrounds.

**You will bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, or related field (Master’s preferred)
* 3-7 years’ experience in process improvement, manufacturing, or quality engineering
* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies (certification is a plus)
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Project management experience is an advantage
* Proficiency in data analysis tools (Minitab, Power BI)
* Results-oriented mindset
* Initiative and proactivity
* Teamwork and collaboration
* Adaptability and openness to change
* Attention to detai

**You will get:**

* Competitive salary package.
* 16 weeks of maternity, paternity, or co-parenting leave.
* Access to a comprehensive training platform.
* Complimentary well-being sessions (physical and psychological).

**Additional Information:**

* Location: Roha, Maharashtra

**About Us**

* Syensqo is a science company developing groundbreaking solutions that enhance the way we live, work, travel and play. Inspired by the scientific councils which Ernest Solvay initiated in 1911, we bring great minds together to push the limits of science and innovation for the benefit of our customers, with a diverse, global team of more than 13,000 associates. Our solutions contribute to safer, cleaner, and more sustainable products found in homes, food and consumer goods, planes, cars, batteries, smart devices and health care applications. Our innovation power enables us to deliver on the ambition of a circular economy and explore breakthrough technologies that advance humanity.
* At Syensqo, we seek to promote unity and not uniformity. We value the diversity that individuals bring and we invite you to consider a future with us, regardless of background, age, gender, national origin, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, ability or identity. We encourage individuals who may require any assistance or accommodations to let us know to ensure a seamless application experience. We are here to support you throughout the application journey and want to ensure all candidates are treated equally. If you are unsure whether you meet all the criteria or qualifications listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply.

title: Associate Engineer, Labview Test Engineering
description:
**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive**
 We’re a global, multi\-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast\-track your career.
   

  

* Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience.
* Combine ingenuity, in\-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence.
* Advance in\-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment.


**What You’ll Be Part Of**
 As a Test Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the quality, performance, and functionality of our products through comprehensive testing procedures. You will be responsible for reviewing circuit designs, developing and optimizing test systems, analyzing test data, and providing valuable insights to improve product reliability and performance. This role offers the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technology and contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering and manufacturing processes. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, manufacturing, and R\&D, to ensure products meet the highest standards of excellence.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Review circuit board designs to ensure they meet testability requirements.
* Provide support to manufacturing by conducting failure analysis, debugging test equipment, and minimizing intermittent failures and downtime.
* Generate test reports, analyse test data, and prepare documentation with recommendations.
* Regularly review test equipment designs, data, and RMA issues with the team.
* Possess advanced knowledge and expertise in TestStand and LabVIEW, including test system development.
* Demonstrate proficiency in vision development and image processing systems, including knowledge of vision systems like Cognex and Banner.
* Have experience in C\+\+ development and executing logic.
* Possess hands\-on experience with PXI controllers, PCI, and troubleshooting related systems.
* Have experience with RF testing and related logic, as well as knowledge of vision systems.
* Demonstrate a solid understanding of CAN and LIN protocols.
* Direct and guide engineering and technical personnel on the operation of test equipment and control apparatus.
* Coordinate engineering activities related to the development, procurement, installation, and calibration of testing instruments, equipment, and control devices to record and analyze test data.
* Optimize test conditions, sequences, and phases of operations.
* Oversee the operational, functional, and performance phases of tests.
* Conduct moderately complex engineering tests on both standard and custom devices.
* Analyze and interpret test data, preparing technical reports for both test engineering and management teams.
* Develop or utilize computer software and hardware for testing machinery and equipment.
* Perform semi\-routine technique development and maintenance, adhering to established standards, including ISO and QS.


**What Makes You A Strong Fit**
* Apply knowledge of electronic circuit analysis.
* Utilize programming skills in LabVIEW, TestStand, C\#, and VB.
* Work with various communication protocols (e.g., CAN, LIN, MOST).
* Contribute to the development of test programs and software.
* Operate and maintain a variety of test instruments.
* Demonstrate electrical circuit analysis skills and the ability to read and interpret schematics.


**Bonus Points if You Have**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Industrial, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience: At least five years of experience in EMS electronic manufacturing as a Test Engineer.
* Strong communication skills and a proven ability to build and collaborate effectively within teams. Extensive experience in the testing domain.


**Things To Know**
* Successfully complete a background investigation and drug screen as a condition of employment
* This position requires the use of a HARMAN or customer\-owned vehicle. As such, any offer of employment will be contingent upon having a clean driving record, which will be evaluated and determined in HARMAN’s sole discretion


**What You Can Expect**
* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in\-person collaboration, with most office\-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to employee discounts on world\-class Harman and Samsung products (JBL, HARMAN Kardon, AKG, etc.)
* Extensive training opportunities through our own HARMAN University
* Competitive wellness benefits
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Access to HARMAN Campus Fitness Center and Cafeteria
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that fosters and encourages professional and personal development.


 \-RD2
   

  

**You Belong Here**
 HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support\-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.
   

  

**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next\-Level Technology**
 Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
   

  

 Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought\-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever\-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award\-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.
   

  

 If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!
   

  

**Important Notice: Recruitment Scams**
 Please be aware that HARMAN recruiters will always communicate with you from an '@harman.com', ‘@careers.harman.com’ or ‘harmanglobal.avature.net’ email address. We will never ask for payments, banking, credit card, personal financial information or access to your LinkedIn/email account during the screening, interview, or recruitment process. If you are asked for such information or receive communication from an email address not ending in one of the above email domains about a job with HARMAN, please cease communication immediately and report the incident to us through: harmancareers@harman.com.
   

  

 HARMAN is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. HARMAN strives to hire the best qualified candidates and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse marketplaces and communities of our global colleagues and customers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. HARMAN attracts, hires, and develops employees based on merit, qualifications and job\-related performance.(www.harman.com)

title: Quality Technician
description:
**Job Purpose**
 To support the Pre\-Dispatch Inspection (PDI) quality activities by ensuring products meet required quality standards before dispatch, assisting in inspection processes, and maintaining proper documentation
   

  

**Job Duties And Responsibilities**
* Assist in conducting pre\-dispatch inspection of products as per defined quality standards and checklists
* Verify fitment, assembly, and functional aspects of products prior to dispatch
* Ensure torque values, specifications, and critical parameters are as per standards
* Support in identifying and reporting defects, deviations, and non\-conformities
* Maintain and update inspection records, check sheets, and reports
* Assist in implementing corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for detected issues
* Coordinate with production and quality teams to resolve quality concerns
* Ensure adherence to quality procedures, work instructions, and safety guidelines
* Participate in process audits and improvement initiatives
* Support in handling customer complaints related to dispatch quality, if any


**Education And Qualifications**
* Diploma / Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical / Electrical / Industrial Engineering (or related field)
* Freshers or candidates with 0–1 year experience can apply


**Skills**
* Basic knowledge of quality concepts and inspection techniques
* Understanding of engineering drawings and specifications (preferred)
* Familiarity with measuring instruments (vernier caliper, torque wrench, etc.)
* Attention to detail and analytical thinking
* Good communication and team coordination skills
* Willingness to learn and adapt in a manufacturing environment
